name: Achilles dipped in the Styx
summary: The scene on this dish depicts a famous event in Greek mythology.  The infant Achilles, one of the heroes of the Trojan War, is being immersed by his mother Thetis in the Styx, the river of the underworld, in order to make him invulnerable.
